description: Operator-valued A^λ_{μν}(I) extraction at A=3 via the refined Sub-lemma 2.1 LR-decomposition formula. Generalized from the A=2-only sublemma_2_1_A_operator_extract.py to arbitrary atomic decompositions using lr_coefficients.lr_coef for the LR table.  Per λ ⊢ 9, fits a least-squares operator A^λ_{μν}(I) ∈ End(V_μ ⊗ V_ν)^(⊕ c^λ_{μν}) satisfying χ^λ(β_1·I·β_2) = Σ_(μ,ν) c^λ_{μν} · Tr(A^λ_{μν}(I) · (ρ_μ(β_1) ⊗ ρ_ν(β_2))).
